QuoteToOpportunitySyncEvent.name: QuoteToOpportunitySyncEvent
QuoteToOpportunitySyncEvent.description: Represents an asynchronous quote to opportunity synchronization event. It tracks whether the sync succeeded or failed and notifies associated subscribers upon completion.

CorrelationIdentifier.description: The caller-specified ID that matches this event to the originating request.

ErrorCode.description: The error code returned when the sync fails. Null when Has Errors is False.

ErrorMessage.description: The error message that explains why the sync failed. Null when Has Errors is False.

HasErrors.description: Indicates whether the sync failed. True if the sync completed with errors or False if the sync succeeded.

OpportunityRecordId.description: The ID of the Opportunity record being synced. Null if the sync fails before an Opportunity is associated.

QuoteRecordId.description: The ID of the Quote record synced to its related Opportunity.

RequestIdentifier.description: The unique identifier for the request that triggered this sync event.

RevenueTransactionErrLogId.description: The ID of the Revenue Transaction Error Log record created when the sync fails. Null when Has Errors is False.
